limitation: Fake success on the original-profile path proves the reviewed no-child grants and lifecycle controls. It does not prove Copilot startup, auth, Auto, permissions, cancel/no-effect, or supported versions.
original_profile_template: (version 1) (import "/System/Library/Sandbox/Profiles/dyld-support.sb") (deny default) (allow file-read* (subpath "${artifact_root}")) (allow file-read* (subpath "${action_root}")) (allow file-write* (subpath "${action_root}")) (allow file-map-executable (literal "${stage_launcher}")) (allow file-map-executable (literal "${approved_original_executable}")) (allow process-exec* (literal "${stage_launcher}")) (allow process-exec* (literal "${approved_original_executable}")) (allow file-read* (subpath "/System/Library")) (allow file-read* (subpath "/usr/lib")) (allow file-map-executable (subpath "/System/Library")) (allow file-map-executable (subpath "/usr/lib")) (allow sysctl-read) (deny file-read* (subpath "${host_home}")) (deny file-write* (subpath "${host_home}")) (deny file-read* (subpath "${repository_root}")) (deny file-write* (subpath "${repository_root}")) (deny file-read* (subpath "${record_root}")) (deny file-write* (subpath "${record_root}")) (deny file-read* (subpath "${blocked_home}")) (deny file-write* (subpath "${blocked_home}")) (deny file-read* (subpath "${blocked_repository}")) (deny file-write* (subpath "${blocked_repository}")) (deny mach-lookup (global-name "com.apple.securityd")) (deny mach-lookup (global-name "com.apple.SecurityServer")) (deny mach-lookup) (deny network*) (deny process-fork)
